title: Private rolling reconciler and State Shuttle for zero-downtime on-prem upgrades
creator: Nora Patel
description: Goal: Ship a safe, auditable upgrade tooling suite for Redwood Private that enables near-zero-downtime major and minor version upgrades across VPC and on-prem clusters. This ticket scopes two coordinated components: (1) Rolling Reconciler: an upgrade coordinator that performs node-level canaries, invariant checks, and progressive traffic shift with deterministic rollback; (2) State Shuttle: a migration helper that safely transposes on-disk/KV state and schema changes in a sidecar-first, backward-compatible fashion.
background: Current private upgrade flow relies on manual runbooks and ad-hoc scripts. Production incidents during schema migrations and KV layout changes have resulted in extended maintenance windows for a subset of customers. Existing upgrade projects focused on orchestrated migrations but left gaps around per-node reconciliation, observable pre/post invariants, and safe state transformation for air-gapped environments. This work combines lessons from recent incidents and the Dedicated rollout playbooks to create a reusable, audit-ready path.
acceptance_criteria: Rolling Reconciler can perform a staged upgrade across a 5-node cluster with configurable canary percentage and automated rollback triggers
Preflight checks cover health, disk pressure, KV integrity checksums, and schema compatibility; preflight must be opt-out=false
State Shuttle performs non-destructive 'shadow copy' of state for at least two common backends (BoltDB-like local store and Redis-compatible KV), with a verification pass against golden dataset
Upgrade run produces an auditable log containing per-step checksums, timestamps, operator decisions, and links to alerting/metrics snapshots
Rollback executes deterministically and recovers cluster to pre-upgrade state within SLA-based timeout for test clusters
End-to-end automated test harness reproduces upgrade and rollback flows in CI against representative cluster fixtures
tasks: Design: write PRD and sequence diagram for Rolling Reconciler and State Shuttle (link in comments)
Infra: add cluster-scoped CRDs for UpgradePlan and ReconcileRun (safe, opt-in during alpha)
Runtime: implement sidecar State Shuttle with copy-and-verify mode and dry-run flag
CLI: extend privatectl with 'upgrade plan apply/dry-run/abort' subcommands
Observability: wire reconciliation events to Console with per-step latency and success/failure metrics
Safety: implement gating rules (p50 latency regression <= 1.2x, error rate delta <= 0.5%)
Testing: add integration tests for backup/restore, network partition during migration, and KV schema bump compatibility
Docs: runbook for SOC/SEs with play-by-play and rollback checklist
risk_considerations: On-prem customers have varied storage semantics; State Shuttle must detect fsync semantics and fallback to offline migration when unsafe
Network partitions during state shuttle copy can cause split-brain if migration is applied in-place; design enforces shadow-copy then switch
Large clusters may have prolonged validation phases—need configurable parallelism and throttling
Operator error: expose informative dry-run output and require explicit acceptance for destructive steps
rollout_gates: Canary window: 1 node or 10% of capacity for 30 minutes with health checks passing
Metric gates: request success rate >= 99.9% for canary window; p99 latency regression <= 2x baseline
Data gates: state checksum verification must match golden copy; delta tolerance = 0 rows
Manual approval: security and customer success approval required for clusters with regulated data
Automatic rollback triggers: >0.5% error increase, disk pressure > 85%, failed checksum verification
observability_plan: Emit ReconcileRun events to Console (trace id, step, node, status)
Capture timestamps for each migration phase and persist artifacts to tenant S3 or on-prem tarball
Dashboard: per-cluster upgrade health, canary outcomes, and long-tail latency (p95/p99)
Integrate with Alerting: dedicated alert channel with run id and 'abort' link
testing_strategy: Local CI: unit tests for state transformation functions and checksum generators
Integration: cluster fixture in CI that runs full upgrade/rollback using test fixtures (small/medium/large)
Chaos: introduce network partition and node restarts during canary phase to validate reconciler resilience
Golden dataset: maintain representative snapshots for Redis-like and BoltDB-like stores to validate State Shuttle
security_and_compliance: All migration artifacts stored in encrypted buckets (KMS) when persisted off-node
Audit log retention: default 90 days with per-customer override
Require RBAC control for 'apply' and 'abort' actions; integrate with SSO groups
deliverables: CI: upgrade-e2e job that runs nightly against canary fixtures
